garage.name: A lock-up garage
garage.about: One bare bulb, a roll-up door and room for a mat and two bags. Cold in winter, cheap all year.

unit.name: A unit on the estate
unit.about: An old print shop with a leaking skylight. Room for mats, bags and a corner for weights.

hall.name: An old hall
hall.about: A gym that's closing, sold to you as it stands: high ceilings, a tired ring and members who stayed.
